rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an old collectible object valued for its historical or aesthetic significance.

example.english: This antique was left to me by my grandfather.
example.traditional: 呢件古董係我阿爺留畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 gu2 dung2 hai6 ngo5 aa3 je4 lau4 bei2 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use 古老 as the all-purpose choice for something belonging to a long-ago period rather than modern times.

example.english: This antique city wall is still very well preserved.
example.traditional: 呢座古老嘅城牆仲保存得好好。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gu2 lou5 ge3 sing4 coeng4 zung6 bou2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use 舊式 specifically for an old-style design, object, or way of doing things that is no longer current.

example.english: Grandma still uses an antique rice cooker.
example.traditional: 阿婆仲用緊舊式嘅電飯煲。
example.jyutping: aa3 po4 zung6 jung6 gan2 gau6 sik1 ge3 din6 faan6 bou1

rows.note: Use 過時 when the emphasis is that something is out of date or no longer fashionable.

example.traditional: 嗰種髮型而家睇落已經過時喇。
example.jyutping: go2 zung2 faat3 jing4 ji4 gaa1 tai2 lok6 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4 laa3

rows.note: Use 老套 for a style, idea, or manner that feels unfashionably old-fashioned, often with a mildly negative tone.

example.english: Your way of proposing is really antique and clichéd.
example.traditional: 你呢個求婚方法真係好老套。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 kau4 fan1 fong1 faat3 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 tou3
